Meta.title: Launch Check — Check before you launch
Meta.description: Scan the website or Android app you built with vibe coding for free. Find leaked keys, exposed files and launch mistakes in minutes.

Home.title: Check before you launch
Home.subtitle: Scan the website or Android app you built with Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, FlutterFlow or Expo. Learn about common mistakes, what they mean and how to fix them, in plain language.

checks.secrets: API keys leaked into your code (OpenAI, Stripe, Supabase service_role…)
checks.files: .env, .git and backup files readable from the internet
checks.build: Debug builds, debug certificates and development settings
checks.network: Forgotten localhost/staging addresses and unencrypted connections
checks.launch: SEO, privacy policy and Google Play requirements

how.one: Enter your site address or upload your APK.
how.two: We scan in 1-2 minutes, looking only at public files.
how.three: Get a scored report and fix prompts you can paste into your AI tool.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: Launch Check is a free tool that helps you find common mistakes before you launch. We work with as little data as possible.

stored.report: The scan report: the scanned site's base address (e.g. https://yoursite.com) or the app's package name, the score and the findings.
stored.evidence: Finding evidence: things like file paths and header names. Keys we find are stored only in masked form (first 6 and last 4 characters).
stored.rate: To prevent abuse, a one-way hash of the IP address is kept only in Redis, with an expiry: up to 1 hour for quick scans and up to 24 hours for deep scans. It is then deleted automatically.

notStored.apk: The APK you upload: deleted as soon as the scan ends (even if it fails).
notStored.filename: Your file name, your full site address or your page content.
notStored.account: Accounts, emails or personal information: there's no sign-up.
notStored.secrets: The full value of keys we find: never stored, never logged.

Privacy.retention: Reports are deleted automatically after 7 days. Anyone with the report link can see it during that time, so share the link with care.
Privacy.scan: We only look at public files. We never try to read from or write to your site's or app's backend (Supabase, Firebase, APIs). Our bot identifies itself as LaunchCheckBot.
Privacy.contact: Write to us with questions or deletion requests.

deep.screenshots: We open your site in a real browser and take screenshots. They're deleted together with the report after 7 days.
deep.visitors: We browse your site like a first-time visitor: we open pages and click "Reject" in the cookie banner. We never type into or submit forms or try to log in.
deep.competitors: We open public pages of the sites you enter as competitors and of example sites in your category (respecting robots.txt). We don't run security checks on them; results are cached for all users for 24 hours.
deep.google: For real-user speed data (CrUX), only the site's address is sent to Google.
deep.services: For subdomain and archive checks only the domain is sent to crt.sh, Cert Spotter, the Internet Archive and RDAP; for video checks only the video ID is sent to YouTube.
deep.ai: Page content isn't sent to any third-party AI service. Content commentary (when enabled) is done by a local model running on our own server.
deep.values: We don't read cookie or browser storage VALUES; we only record their names and security settings.

start.intro: The deep scan opens your site in a real browser: it measures how it looks on phones, its speed, cookie consent, the sign-up path and how you compare with competitors. It takes about 15 minutes.
start.details: Optionally add up to 3 competitors. We only open pages like a normal visitor; we don't run security checks on competitors.

benchmark.rebuildIntro: Rework the home page of my site at {target} ({title}) following the common structure of similar successful sites. Use these sections in this order:

rebuildSection.hero: a headline saying what I offer in one sentence, a subheadline saying who it's for and why it matters, one clear action button and a product visual
rebuildSection.logos: logos of customers or partners I really work with (skip this section if I have none)
rebuildSection.testimonials: real customer testimonials with names and roles (don't invent any)
rebuildSection.pricing: plans and prices; highlight the recommended plan
rebuildSection.faq: the questions visitors ask most, with short answers
rebuildSection.how_it_works: how it works in a few steps
rebuildSection.features: the most important features, each with its benefit
rebuildSection.final_cta: a repeated call to action at the end of the page

benchmark.rebuildRules: Rules: Write the copy for my product; ask me about my product, audience and the proof I have. Don't use other sites' text, slogans, images or brand names. Don't invent numbers, reviews or logos I don't have. Use my existing design components.

Bot.title: LaunchCheckBot
Bot.intro: LaunchCheckBot is Launch Check's scanning bot. It visits your site when a user starts a scan, when it's entered as a competitor, or as one of the example sites in its category.
Bot.ua: Its user agent always contains "LaunchCheckBot/1.0" and the address of this page. On pages opened in a real browser, the same identity is appended to the browser information.

does.pages: Opens public pages, images and scripts like a normal visitor.
does.banner: Only clicks "Reject / Necessary only" in cookie banners.
does.files: When the site owner starts the scan, checks commonly forgotten public files (e.g. /.env, /.git/config).

doesNot.forms: Doesn't type into or submit forms, or try to log in or sign up.
doesNot.apis: Doesn't send its own requests to the site's APIs; never uses keys or tokens it finds.
doesNot.competitors: Doesn't run security checks on competitor or example sites; only looks at page structure.
doesNot.load: Opens at most a few pages per site and spaces out requests to the same site.

Bot.block: Add these lines to your robots.txt and we won't visit your site in competitor and example site scans:
Bot.blockNote: When site owners scan their own site, robots.txt isn't consulted; that scan is the owner's request.
Bot.contact: Write to us about a problem with our bot or a removal request.
